request: In the editor, an installed @types package missing from tsconfig `types` hides its typings even when the code imports it. Add to src/lib/tsconfig.ts: declaresGlobals(dtsText) - true when a .d.ts declares globals (a script with no top-level import/export, or one containing `declare global`, or `declare module "x"` blocks), false for plain modules; importedTypesPackages(sourceText) - the @types package names a file imports via import/import type/ export-from/side-effect imports/dynamic import()/require()/`/// <reference types>`, skipping relative paths and node: builtins, taking the package name from deep paths, and mapping scoped names to the @types form ("@tanstack/solid-virtual/core" -> "tanstack__solid-virtual"). Use them in intellisense.ts so imported packages count as allowed and only global-declaring files of hidden packages are held back.
